mentions.name: trailer.dev
mentions.description: This is a self-hostable development environment platform that lets teams set up complex, collaborative development environments without needing expertise in reverse proxies, NVIDIA drivers, or Docker. Kubernetes support is currently in development.
mentions.problem: Data scientists often cannot set up complex environments for their projects — reverse proxies, NVIDIA drivers, Docker — especially ones that support collaborative work.
mentions.audience: Data scientists who need complex, collaborative development environments but lack infrastructure expertise.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://trailer.dev, a self-hostable development environment platform.
mentions.author: oesa
